title: Concept: Registry index addressed over SSH
description: .cargo/config.toml declares an index URL that relies on SSH host trust, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an index URL that relies on SSH host trust.
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an index URL that relies on SSH host trust.
